name: Izuki — AI on your screen
description: Izuki in your browser: a side panel that answers about the page you're on using whichever AI you already have open — ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Copilot, Perplexity or any tab you pick — or Izuki on your PC; follows the questions on a page for you; hands a reviewed job to your PC; plus explain, translate, sum up, read aloud or save anything, and a focus guard.
